title: Keryx conditional reference declarations
description: .metaproject/rules/project/references.json. See README.md section 5.1. Each entry declares a document that project rules cite, where it applies (file globs and task keywords), the section that matters (anchor) and what it governs. A path must be relative and stay inside the project root; JSON Schema cannot express that normalisation, so the loader (src/gdskills/references-config.ts) also rejects a path that escapes the root.

path.description: Project-relative path of the document; absolute paths and paths escaping the root are rejected.

globs.description: Globs matched against the task's files; a match promotes the reference.

keywords.description: Words matched case-insensitively, on a word boundary, against the task text.

anchor.description: Heading text or slug of the section that matters; without it the whole file is the obligation.

description.description: What the document governs and when to read it.
